characters: Lucia Caminos: First female HD-era Grand Theft Auto protagonist, former inmate at Leonida State Penitentiary, partnering with Jason Duval.
Jason Duval: Combat veteran and Lucia's partner in crime, operating tactical stick-ups and heist operations across Vice Dale and Port Gellhorn.
Raul Bautista: High-profile cartel logistics broker operating maritime smuggling corridors through the Leonida Keys.
locations: Vice City: Metropolis in Vice Dale County including districts like Ocean Beach, Washington Beach, Vice Beach, Little Haiti, Little Havana, and Starfish Island.
Leonida Keys: Archipelagic chain south of the mainland connected by Overseas Highway US-1, known for cigarette boat smuggling, game fishing, and coral flats.
Mount Kalaga National Park: Rugged northern interior wilderness featuring dense pine forests, hunting reserves, and mountain switchbacks.
Port Gellhorn: Industrial port and working-class hub west of Vice City featuring refinery infrastructure and strip malls.
Ambrosia: Rural agricultural and sugar cane community in central Leonida.
technology_and_platform: Rockstar Advanced Game Engine (RAGE 9): Proprietary engine powering physics-driven ocean wave displacement, ray-traced lighting, and dynamic weather.
Leonida Vice Broadcast: Live synchronized community broadcast player featuring 8x Forensic Loupe, Bi-directional X-Ray Telemetry, and real-time Citizen Wire.
Launch Date: Grand Theft Auto VI launch window is confirmed for Fall 2026 (November 19, 2026).
